Product Features

  • Space utilization: The size is 140.57482 cm, and the width can reach 161 cm when unfolded. It can be flexibly switched between sofa and bed to meet the needs of different scenarios.
  • Material combination: From the outside to the inside, washcloths, loose cotton, non-woven fabric and sponge are used as materials, which ensure a soft and pleasant sitting experience.
  • Additional configuration: Equipped with 5 cm high sofa legs made of ordinary plastic and a hidden small MDF table, it is practical and comfortable.
  • Convenient Charging: Equipped with USB and Type-C ports, you can easily charge your electronic devices.
  • Mobility and stability: With sturdy sofa legs and smooth-running casters, it offers both stability and convenient mobility.
  • Storage Design: Equipped with cup holders, hidden storage space, and a hidden side table with cup holders, it allows for more flexible storage and placement of items.
  • Angle adjustment: The backrest can be adjusted in three angles: 108°, 135° and 180°, so you can sit or lie down as you wish.
  • Seating experience: The backrest and seat cushion are soft and can provide a comfortable sitting or lying experience.
  • Shape Adaptability: The foldable design with multi-angle adjustment can be used as a sofa for daily leisure and can be turned into a comfortable bed when unfolded. It is suitable for various needs such as rest and entertainment in small apartments.
  • NOTE: This product comes in 3 packages and may not arrive at the same time. Please make sure that both packages have been delivered before assembly!
